title: Excaliself
name: excaliself
description: Self-hosted Excalidraw whiteboards for teams, with accounts, live collaboration, a shared team space, folders and search. Drawings are stored in Postgres. Source: https://github.com/maciekzygmunt/excaliself

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24. Use hex, because it goes into a connection URL. Keep it the same when you redeploy.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.label: Auth secret (required)
env.description: At least 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32

env.name: BASE_URL
env.label: Address you open Excaliself at
env.description: Port included, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://draw.example.com. Sign-in refuses any other address.

env.name: EXCALISELF_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Set the database password (openssl rand -hex 24) and the auth secret (openssl rand -base64 32) before you deploy. The stack won't start without them. Set the address to where you will open the app, e.g. http://<your-host>:3000. Then open it: the first visitor creates the admin account, so do this right away. Drawings are stored in the pgdata volume. For a public server, put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front. Docs: excaliself.com/docs
